b1-07-01.title: Communicative Challenge: How I Used to Study
b1-07-01.scenario: You are Meg. Carlos asks how you studied when you were a student at school. You used to study a lot before exams, and last year you passed a difficult subject at university.
b1-07-01.prompt: Tell Carlos how you used to study and what you passed last year.
cues: Say what you used to do before exams
Say what you passed last year
b1-07-01.target: Cuando era estudiante, estudiaba mucho antes de los exámenes. El año pasado aprobé una asignatura difícil.
b1-07-01.english: When I was a student, I used to study a lot before exams. Last year I passed a difficult subject.
b1-07-01.canDo: I can describe past learning experiences clearly.

b1-07-02.title: Communicative Challenge: How We Learn
b1-07-02.scenario: You are Carlos. Meg asks how to learn Spanish well. You tell her that a lot is learned through practice and that you have to concentrate during the class.
b1-07-02.prompt: Tell Meg two general things about learning, without naming a person.
cues: Say what is learned through practice
Say what you have to do in class
b1-07-02.target: Se aprende mucho con la práctica. Hay que concentrarse durante la clase.
b1-07-02.english: A lot is learned through practice. You have to concentrate during the lesson.
b1-07-02.canDo: I can describe learning processes impersonally.

b1-07-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Studying in a Group
b1-07-03.scenario: You are Meg. Carlos asks what you think about studying in a group. You think it is useful, but you do not think that studying alone is always better.
b1-07-03.prompt: Tell Carlos your opinion about studying in a group and about studying alone.
cues: Say what you think about studying in a group
Say what you do not think about studying alone
b1-07-03.target: Creo que estudiar en grupo es útil, pero no creo que estudiar solo sea siempre mejor.
b1-07-03.english: I think studying in a group is useful, but I don't think studying alone is always better.
b1-07-03.canDo: I can express opinions with the indicative or subjunctive as appropriate.

b1-07-04.title: Communicative Challenge: The Best Way to Learn
b1-07-04.scenario: You are Carlos. Meg asks which way of learning is better. For you, practice is more effective than memorising lists, and practising with other people is the best option.
b1-07-04.prompt: Compare practice with memorising lists and say what is the best option for you.
cues: Say what the best option is for you
b1-07-04.target: La práctica es más eficaz que memorizar listas. Para mí, practicar con otras personas es la mejor opción.
b1-07-04.english: Practice is more effective than memorising lists. For me, practising with other people is the best option.

b1-07-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Rousseau and Emilio
b1-07-05.scenario: You are Meg. You have just read about Rousseau and his book Emilio, and Carlos asks what Rousseau thinks about learning. For Rousseau, a child learns from experience and not only by memorising, and the teacher prepares situations.
b1-07-05.prompt: Tell Carlos what Rousseau says about how a child learns and what the teacher does.
b1-07-05.target: Según Rousseau, el niño aprende con la experiencia y no solo memorizando. El profesor prepara situaciones para que el niño descubra.
b1-07-05.english: According to Rousseau, the child learns from experience and not only by memorising. The teacher prepares situations so that the child discovers.
b1-07-05.canDo: I can state and defend an opinion about education.

b1-07-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: My Opinion on Learning
b1-07-consolidation.scenario: You are Meg. Carlos asks what you think is the best way to learn. You think practice is more effective than memorising lists, because it allows you to apply what you have learned.
b1-07-consolidation.prompt: Give your opinion, compare two methods and give a reason.
b1-07-consolidation.target: Creo que la práctica es más eficaz que memorizar listas porque permite aplicar lo aprendido.
b1-07-consolidation.english: I think practice is more effective than memorising lists because it allows you to apply what you have learned.
b1-07-consolidation.canDo: I can talk about education and learning, give opinions and compare methods.
